theories.claim: Aerobic-respiration enzymes correlate with oxygen level
theories.verdict: Supported — strongly once cytochrome bd is excluded
Supported: 4 KOs miss ~45 % of known H2 oxidisers under any rule

theories.claim: Errors come from incomplete / over-broad KO definitions
theories.verdict: Supported: for 4 groups one specific KO beats the 'any KO' rule by ≥ 0.3 MCC out-of-genus
Partly: two oxygen sources agree at κ 0.72 — substantial but not perfect

theories.claim: Poor genome quality causes missed detections
